# Bench guess about remnant pooling

An unsourced note suggests G4 and G9 may be interchangeable because a dried spot looked similar. No comparison ticket, controlled trial or acceptance event accompanies that claim. It has not been adopted. The maintained [pairing boundary](glaze-pairing.md) remains the applicable rule.

The note is retained to show what was proposed, not to establish that the families are interchangeable.
